project_type: Laravel 12 tutoring marketplace with Livewire 3, Paystack payments, and Jitsi sessions
build_system: Composer for PHP dependencies, npm for frontend assets (Tailwind CSS)
test_framework: No test framework currently configured in the project
build_command: composer install && npm install && npm run build
test_command: None currently configured - manual testing via php artisan serve
verification_instructions: 1. Start dev server with 'php artisan serve'. 2. Run migrations with 'php artisan migrate'. 3. Test each feature manually via browser at http://localhost:8000. 4. Check Laravel logs in storage/logs/laravel.log for any errors.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - no generated code that gets checked in
environment_constraints: Windows environment with PowerShell; Laravel 12 with PHP 8.4; existing OTP system already in place for email verification; social OAuth with Google/GitHub/Facebook already configured; Password::defaults() not yet configured in AppServiceProvider
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found - follow Laravel conventions. All migrations must be independent and never modify existing tables destructively. Match existing code style and patterns from OtpService.
key_patterns: Services pattern (OtpService in app/Services/ with branded email HTML template using Fraunces/DM Sans fonts, --ink/#15281F, --trust-blue/#0A64BC, --coral, --mint CSS vars). Controllers in app/Http/Controllers/Auth/ for auth flows. Middleware in app/Http/Middleware/. Blade views in resources/views/auth/ with two-panel layout (dark brand panel left, white form panel right). Routes in routes/web.php with named routes. User model at app/Models/User.php with role helper methods (isAdmin, isTutor, isStudent, isParent).
directory_structure: app/Services/ for business logic services; app/Http/Controllers/Auth/ for authentication controllers; app/Http/Middleware/ for custom middleware; app/Models/ for Eloquent models; app/Providers/ for service providers; database/migrations/ for DB schema; resources/views/auth/ for auth UI; routes/web.php for web routes
